title: CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection
abstract: arXiv:2610.14021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. translated_title: CoEvoke：唤起多智能体协作以进行轨迹收集
translated_abstract: 训练多智能体协作需要包含检查、反馈和修复过程的轨迹，然而任务求解的rollout可能以立即通过告终，或在没有有效纠正的情况下重复不成功的尝试。我们提出CoEvoke，这是一个跨领域框架，能够在轨迹收集过程中唤起这些交互。受控扰动创造了可恢复的困难，而受限的基于参考的指导则引导探究方向。所得数据集包含涵盖4,130个软件工程与推理任务的4,567条可重构轨迹，将公开交互与证据、决策及任务原生结果相关联。在2,287个同任务对上进行的独立实验显示，七个扰动组中的反馈增加了47.72-100个百分点；指导的效果较小且依赖于具体模型。在训练任务、决策记录数量和更新完全相同的情况下，经扰动增强的裁判训练提升了ACPBench-Hard基…
tldr: CoEvoke通过在轨迹收集中引入受控扰动和受限参考指导，唤起多智能体的检查-反馈-修复交互，构建了包含4,567条可重构轨迹的数据集，显著提升反馈频率并改善裁判模型性能。
en_tdlr: CoEvoke is a cross-domain framework that evokes check-feedback-repair interactions during trajectory collection via controlled perturbations and restricted reference-based guidance, producing a dataset of 4,567 reconstructable trajectories that significantly boosts feedback rates and improves judge model performance.
